# Pull requests GitHub reports as MERGED whose commit is deliberately not on
# main, one per line: "<pr-number> <reason>".
#
# A PR lands here only when it was merged into a base branch that never itself
# reached main, AND its content has been re-landed by another PR that did.
# Re-landing creates a new commit; the original merge commit stays unreachable
# forever, so without this list the check would go permanently red the moment it
# succeeded at its job.
#
# Two rules keep the list from rotting into a blanket suppression:
#   - an entry with no reason is rejected;
#   - an entry for a PR that IS on main is rejected as stale.

245 merged into fix/probe-guard-contradicts-shipped-chart five minutes after #250 squash-merged that branch to main; re-landed as #256
